'''Virtual Set 18 (Re-organized)''', planned as '''Fifth Anthology''', was previewed in June 2009 as the 18th numbered Original-era Virtual Set but never shipped as a standalone Remaster PDF. Its preview material was released inside Reflections IV ([[Virtual Block 6]]; PDF official text 4 September 2009).

Block introductions still count a reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets.
